rca of the issue: Two environmental issues encountered (both worked around, no code fix required): (1) Main agent's temp superadmin was inserted with default Mongo ObjectId as _id; login returned a JWT whose sub was the hex ObjectId, but /api/auth/me and the auth dependency look up users by string UUID _id, so every authenticated call returned 401 'User tidak ditemukan'. Fixed by deleting and re-inserting the temp super with a proper str(uuid.uuid4()) _id. (2) The user's canonical superadmin phone has been changed from 081200000001 → 08123456789 sometime between iter11 and now; all pytest regression suites hardcode 081200000001 and would fail at the login fixture. Documented as action item — did not attempt to modify user's account.
